caption: The drawing depicts a single metal implement placed diagonally on a plain, light beige background. The object has two distinct ends: on the left side, there is an oval-shaped, flat head with five circular holes evenly spaced across its surface. The middle section of the object is a long, straight handle that appears to have a slightly worn, rusty, and brownish-gray surface. Partway along the handle, there are two circular elements that look like collars or stops. On the right end, the object terminates in a two-pronged, curved fork. The entire implement is illustrated in muted, earthy tones, primarily rust-brown and gray, consistent with aged or iron material. There are no additional elements or objects present in the drawing aside from this single utensil.
title: Fork
